task.title: Define RED tests for CLI option values that begin with a dash (F-013)
task.description: Write failing tests pinning that every string-valued CLI option accepts a value beginning with '-', which base64url identity_id values produce roughly once in 64. Do NOT write implementation code.
task.scope: apps/cli tests only. Do not modify apps/relay or packages/**.

acceptance_criteria: F-013 (blocker): a deterministic test proves that `send --to <identity>` succeeds when the identity_id begins with '-'. Today Node parseArgs with strict:true raises ERR_PARSE_ARGS_INVALID_OPTION_VALUE for any option value starting with '-', which cli.ts:66 maps to INVALID_ARGUMENTS / exit 2. The test must currently FAIL.

The test class is enumerated, not sampled: every string-valued option across the documented command surface is covered - at minimum --to, --with, --text, --profile, --out, --from, --message-id, --relay-url, --store-key-env - each asserted with a value beginning with '-'. Use fixed literal values; do not rely on randomly generated identities to hit the case.
A `--text` value beginning with '-' is accepted as message content, including a value that looks like a known flag (for example '--profile'), and is not reinterpreted as an option.

Genuinely invalid input still fails closed with exit 2: an unknown flag, a missing required value, and a repeated option must keep their current INVALID_ARGUMENTS behaviour. Assert these so the fix cannot be obtained by simply disabling strict parsing.
`--` end-of-options handling, if the fix introduces it, is pinned by a test rather than left implicit.
The existing exit-code contract is unchanged for every other case, and the one JSON object on stdout / redacted diagnostics on stderr behaviour still holds.
All currently-passing tests stay green; no existing assertion is weakened or deleted.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; project root is /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet.
Load and follow the project tests-creator skill and the project testing skill; preserve explicit RED-before-GREEN evidence with recorded command output.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not weaken or delete existing assertions, and do not modify the T36-owned harness build sequencing in apps/cli/vitest.config.ts or apps/cli/test/globalSetup.ts beyond reading them.
The tests must be deterministic. Do not depend on a randomly generated identity happening to start with '-'; construct the case explicitly.
Use `keryx ctx rg` for searches, never bare rg/grep. Use `keryx ctx run` for long command output.
Never print plaintext message bodies, ciphertext, profile store keys, private key material or HTTP request bodies into reports or logs.
Do not commit: this repository has an unborn untracked baseline, so partial root commits are forbidden.
Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T39-tests-result.json and make the final response start with STATUS:.

In the result, list every added test by file and test name, state the exact failing assertion, and name every string-valued option you enumerated so the reviewer can confirm the class is complete rather than sampled.
